import BouquetDetailPage from '@/components/pages/BouquetDetailPage/BouquetDetailPage';
import { Footer } from '@/components/widgets/Footer/Footer';
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation';
export default async function Fixture({params}: {params: Promise<{locale:string}>}) {
 const {locale}=await params;
 if (locale !== 'en' && locale !== 'ru' && locale !== 'sr') notFound();
 return <><BouquetDetailPage locale={locale}/><Footer/></>;
}
